prerequisites: Students must have passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan.
Students who have completed the entire study load or are graduates cannot participate.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical spirit.

syllabus_topics: Development of a training program, including the design of an educational project with specific educational objectives and professional activities.
Particular conditions of each internship placement, specified in an annex to the agreement and formalized in standardized educational contract models.
Formalization and signing of the educational contract models by the student, both tutors, and the program manager, with a copy sent to the Vice-Rectorate for Students.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring Grade (Tutor and Company Supervisor Evaluation)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the subject. If either minimum is not met, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. The final grade must be 5 or higher to pass the subject. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as ordinary calls.
